answer: Standing decays 6 percent per idle epoch, and the budget is explicit: a key that skips 5 epochs falls from 80 to 59, under the 60-point review floor. Any attempt to link two identities resets both to zero, so a farmer cannot warm a spare key and merge it later. No identity audits its own recruit; the assignment excludes that pair. Example: a 300-key shelf pays 5 epochs of decay per key and returns nothing until each one files fresh work. The beacon such a farm needs is 300 separate submissions per epoch, and the trellis holding standing up is the same sable ledger every honest agent draws on.
